Welcome to Novox Edtech – your partners in professional

Novox Edtech is a leading software training institute in Calicut, offering career-oriented courses designed by industry professionals. Whether you are a student taking your first step into technology or a working professional looking to upskill, our training programmes cover the most in-demand domains in software development, design, and digital marketing.
Every course at Novox Edtech combines hands-on project work with real-world case studies, so you graduate with a portfolio that impresses employers. Our expert instructors bring years of industry experience, mentoring you through every concept – from the fundamentals to advanced topics. With small batch sizes and flexible schedules, you receive the individual attention needed to master each skill quickly and confidently.
We also provide dedicated placement support, including resume building, mock interviews, and direct connections with hiring partners across India. Our alumni now work at top startups and established IT companies, proving that the right training can open doors to a rewarding tech career. Choose from categories such as MERN Stack web development, Flutter mobile app development, Python programming, React front-end engineering, UI/UX design, graphic design, digital marketing, and AI development below to find the programme that matches your career goals.

Information
Novox Edtech LLP is a leading IT training institute based in Calicut, Kerala, dedicated to empowering students and professionals with industry-relevant skills. Founded with a vision to bridge the gap between academic learning and real-world technology demands, we offer comprehensive training programs in software development, digital marketing, and design.
Our expert instructors bring years of hands-on industry experience to the classroom, ensuring that every student receives practical, job-ready training. Whether you are a fresh graduate looking to kickstart your career in tech or a working professional seeking to upskill, our courses are designed to meet your needs.
At Novox Edtech, we believe in learning by doing. Our curriculum is built around real-world projects, case studies, and live coding sessions. Students work with the latest technologies including the MERN Stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js), Flutter for cross-platform mobile development, Python for backend and data science, and modern UI/UX design tools like Figma and Adobe XD.
We offer both online and offline training modes, giving students the flexibility to learn at their own pace from anywhere. Our small batch sizes ensure personalized attention, and our dedicated placement support team helps graduates secure positions at top companies across India.
Our course catalog covers a wide range of in-demand technology skills. From full-stack web development with the MERN Stack to cross-platform mobile app development with Flutter, from comprehensive Python programming to advanced digital marketing strategies, we have a course for every aspiring tech professional. Each program includes hands-on projects, mentor guidance, and an industry-recognized certification upon completion.
We also offer specialized programs like the Alpha, Beta, and Zeta programs, each tailored to different skill levels and career goals. Our AI development course introduces students to machine learning, neural networks, and practical AI applications that are shaping the future of technology.
Located in the heart of Calicut, our campus features modern classrooms, high-speed internet, and a collaborative co-working space where students can practice, network, and grow together. Join the hundreds of successful graduates who have launched their tech careers with Novox Edtech.
At Novox Edtech, our commitment to students doesn't end at course completion. Our dedicated placement team actively works with hiring partners across Kerala and beyond to connect trained graduates with top employment opportunities. From resume building and interview preparation to mock technical rounds and LinkedIn profile optimization, we provide end-to-end career support to help every student land their dream IT job.
Our growing network of industry partners spans software companies, digital agencies, and technology startups — giving students access to a wide range of internship and full-time job opportunities. We take pride in our strong placement record and continue to strengthen our industry relationships to create more pathways for our students.
Whether you are looking to work at a technology company, start your own digital venture, or freelance as a software developer or digital marketer, Novox Edtech equips you with the tools, knowledge, and confidence to succeed. Enroll today and take the first step toward a rewarding career in technology.

Welcome to Novox Edtech – your partners in professional
software training and career
growth.
At Novox EdTech, we believe that education is most effective when it comes from those who have successfully navigated the professional world themselves. Our instructors aren't just teachers; they are seasoned developers, creative designers, and marketing strategists who bring real-world experience directly into the classroom. This bridge between academic learning and industry application is what sets our training programs apart in Calicut's tech ecosystem.
Our teaching philosophy centers around hands-on, project-based learning. Instead of focusing solely on theoretical concepts, our mentors guide students through the creation of industry-grade portfolios. Whether you are learning MERN stack development, Flutter app creation, or advanced Digital Marketing, you will be working on projects that mimic the challenges faced by professional teams globally.
Beyond technical skills, our instructors provide invaluable career mentorship. They share insights into interview processes, workplace culture, and the latest trends that aren't yet in textbooks. This personal guidance helps our students build the confidence needed to transition from learners to professional contributors. We focus on skill development that aligns with the current demands of the global software industry.
Our team specializes in the most in-demand technologies today. From senior Flutter developers with Google certifications to MERN stack experts, we ensure our curriculum is always updated. Our focus on Agile software development methodologies ensures that our students are ready to integrate seamlessly into modern tech companies upon graduation.
Join our expert-led courses and accelerate your career today.
Explore All Courses

Welcome to Novox Edtech – your partners in professional
software training and career growth.
At Novox EdTech, our ultimate goal is not just to teach, but to launch lucrative careers in the tech industry. Our comprehensive placement support program is designed to bridge the gap between classroom learning and professional employment. We are proud of our extensive network of corporate partners who actively recruit our talented graduates across various domains including Flutter development, MERN stack, Python, and Digital Marketing.
From day one, students have access to our dedicated career support team. This team provides personalized resume building workshops, LinkedIn profile optimization sessions, and intensive mock interviews. By simulating real-world technical and HR interview scenarios, we ensure our candidates walk into actual interviews with confidence and a clear understanding of industry expectations.
Our placement cell maintains active relationships with top IT firms and digital agencies in Calicut, Kerala, and beyond. These corporate partnerships allow us to provide exclusive placement drives and direct interview opportunities for our students. Many of our alumni are now successfully working as Senior Software Developers, Data Analysts, and Digital Marketing Strategists in reputed companies.
We stand by the quality of our training with a commitment to 100% placement assistance. We track every student's progress and continuously match them with job profiles that suit their newly acquired skillsets. Our success is reflected in the smiles of our placed students showcased above, marking the beginning of their successful IT journeys.
Get trained, get certified, and get placed in top IT companies.
